scenes.title: Pressure Cooker
scenes.text: Earth holds around thirteen hundred active volcanoes, each one a window into the molten heat deep below our feet.

scenes.title: Molten Core
scenes.text: The center of the Earth is hotter than the surface of the sun, reaching around five thousand four hundred degrees.

scenes.title: Lava
scenes.text: Fresh lava can reach twelve hundred degrees, hot enough to melt rock and set trees ablaze on contact.

scenes.title: Year Without Summer
scenes.text: One eruption in eighteen fifteen threw so much ash into the sky that the next year had no summer at all.

scenes.title: Ash Clouds
scenes.text: Volcanic ash can circle the globe for months, blocking sunlight and changing weather thousands of miles away.

scenes.title: Supervolcano
scenes.text: Under Yellowstone sits a supervolcano so vast that an eruption would reshape a whole continent.

scenes.title: Beyond Earth
scenes.text: Volcanoes exist on other worlds too, and Mars holds the largest volcano known anywhere in the solar system.

scenes.title: Your Turn
scenes.text: The ground beneath you is alive with heat and pressure. Would you live next to an active volcano?
